alt: A bar shows the three components: Written Exam 35%, Individual Report 30%, Team Project 35%. Below, the Team Project produces two shared pieces of evidence, the Explanation of Research and Planning and the Evidence of Action, and one individual Reflective Paper per candidate.
caption: The Team Project is joint-largest with the Written Exam and mixes team and individual evidence.

alt: A tree splits the 70 marks into the Team Element (25: Explanation of Research and Planning 10, Evidence of Action 5, collaboration 5 for the whole team and 5 individual) and the Personal Element (45: evaluation of action and teamwork 10, reflection on learning 15, reflection on teamwork 10, communication 10).
caption: Only 25 marks are shared; 50 of the 70 marks are individual.

after: ## How the Team Project actually runs
alt: Five numbered steps: choose a topic and local issue, research different aspects, decide on a course of action, carry out the action, and measure its success. Below, the Explanation of Research and Planning grows in three stages: topic and issue, plan and roles, then a review of changes.
caption: Research is shared out, the action is agreed together, and the planning document grows as the project runs.

after: ## How the Team Project actually runs
alt: Ticked list of acceptable forms of Evidence of Action: posters, leaflets, web pages, videos of up to 10 minutes, presentations and event photographs. A separate panel marks evidence of research or planning meetings as not counting.
caption: Evidence of Action must show the action itself, in any suitable form.

after: ## Word and time limits that cost marks if ignored
alt: Three length scales. Explanation of Research and Planning: 300 to 400 words, nothing after 400 marked. Evidence of Action video: nothing after 10 minutes marked. Reflective Paper: 750 to 1000 words, nothing after 1000 marked, so a 1400-word paper is marked only on its first 1000.
caption: Anything past the cap earns nothing.

alt: Three parts of the Reflective Paper: summarise your research findings and how the team used them; reflect on what you learned about the issue, teamwork and yourself; evaluate the action and your own collaboration. Facts: 750 to 1000 words of continuous text, usually first person, sub-headings allowed, worth 45 of the 70 marks.
caption: The Reflective Paper is where an individual grade is mostly decided.

after: ## Collaboration (10 marks, part of the Team Element)
alt: Seven observed behaviours around a central Collaboration hub: clear communication, sharing ideas, agreeing targets and deadlines, solving problems, flexibility, dividing tasks and recognising contributions, and giving and asking for support. Collaboration is 10 marks: 5 for the whole team and 5 individual.
caption: Collaboration is observed, not automatic, and half of it is marked individually.
